statement.zh: Joshi《Excavations at Surkotada》(MASI 87, 1990) 正式报告 1971–72 苏尔科塔达发掘与卡奇勘查。
statement.en: Joshi’s Excavations at Surkotada (MASI 87, 1990) formally reports the 1971–72 excavations and related Kutch exploration.
